name: Deprecation Status
description: Shows data about the deprecation status of drupal.org projects.
project_description:
Drupal.org produces a regular report to check contributed projects for deprecated API uses and major version compatibility using the Project Analysis pipelines. This project summarises the results and displays them in an easy to digest interactive form to help make sense of the status of the Drupal ecosystem for the upcoming major version.

 
 Not the module you are looking for! 
 This project was not designed to install on your Drupal site. For a live version of Drupal ecosystem compatibility information with up to date data check out https://dev.acquia.com/drupal11/deprecation_status/projects 

 To check the readiness of your own site, use Upgrade Status module !
